exams.name: Certified Chief Information Security Officer
exams.blurb: Executive EC-Council certification covering governance, controls and audit, programme management, core competencies and strategic security planning.

exams.name: Certified Ethical Hacker
exams.blurb: Widely recognised EC-Council multiple-choice exam covering reconnaissance, scanning, exploitation, malware, web attacks and cloud hacking techniques.

exams.name: Certified Ethical Hacker (Practical)
exams.blurb: Six-hour hands-on EC-Council exam requiring candidates to compromise live targets; passing both CEH exams earns the CEH Master designation.

exams.name: Certified Network Defender
exams.blurb: EC-Council blue-team certification covering network defence controls, perimeter security, endpoint protection, monitoring and threat response.

exams.name: Certified Penetration Testing Professional
exams.blurb: Fully hands-on EC-Council penetration testing exam in a live cyber range covering pivoting, IoT, OT, binary exploitation and Active Directory attacks.

exams.name: Certified SOC Analyst
exams.blurb: EC-Council entry-level SOC certification covering security operations processes, SIEM administration, log analysis and incident triage workflows.

exams.name: Certified Threat Intelligence Analyst
exams.blurb: EC-Council certification covering the threat intelligence lifecycle, data collection, analysis techniques, attribution and intelligence reporting.

exams.name: Computer Hacking Forensic Investigator
exams.blurb: EC-Council digital forensics certification covering evidence handling, disk and memory forensics, network and cloud forensics and expert reporting.

exams.name: EC-Council Certified Incident Handler
exams.blurb: EC-Council certification on incident handling and response covering preparation, detection, containment, eradication, recovery and lessons learned.

exams.name: Licensed Penetration Tester (Master)
exams.blurb: EC-Council master designation awarded to candidates who score 90 percent or above on the CPENT practical penetration testing range exam.

exams.name: Certified Cloud Security Professional
exams.blurb: Advanced ISC2 cloud security certification covering architecture, data security, platform security, operations and legal and compliance risk.

exams.name: Certified Information Systems Security Professional
exams.blurb: Flagship ISC2 credential covering eight security domains and requiring five years of paid experience; widely required for senior security roles.

exams.name: Certified Secure Software Lifecycle Professional
exams.blurb: ISC2 certification on embedding security through the software development lifecycle, from requirements and design to testing, deployment and disposal.

exams.name: CISSP Information Systems Security Architecture Professional
exams.blurb: CISSP concentration for security architects covering identity architecture, secure design, infrastructure security and architecture governance.

exams.name: CISSP Information Systems Security Engineering Professional
exams.blurb: CISSP concentration on systems security engineering, developed with the NSA, covering secure lifecycle, risk management and technical management.

exams.name: CISSP Information Systems Security Management Professional
exams.blurb: CISSP concentration for security managers covering programme leadership, risk, threat intelligence, contingency planning and law and ethics.

exams.name: Governance, Risk and Compliance Certification
exams.blurb: ISC2 credential on authorising information systems under frameworks such as NIST RMF; renamed from Certified Authorization Professional in 2023.

exams.name: ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity
exams.blurb: Entry-level ISC2 certification covering security principles, business continuity, access control, network security and security operations basics.

exams.name: Systems Security Certified Practitioner
exams.blurb: ISC2 practitioner certification for hands-on security administrators covering access controls, monitoring, incident response, cryptography and networks.

exams.name: Certified Data Privacy Solutions Engineer
exams.blurb: ISACA technical privacy certification covering privacy governance, privacy architecture and the data lifecycle for engineers implementing controls.

exams.name: Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control
exams.blurb: ISACA certification on enterprise IT risk identification, assessment, response and control monitoring and reporting for risk practitioners.

exams.name: Certified in the Governance of Enterprise IT
exams.blurb: ISACA credential for executives responsible for IT governance frameworks, strategic alignment, benefits realisation and resource optimisation.

exams.name: Certified Information Security Manager
exams.blurb: ISACA management certification covering information security governance, risk management, programme development and incident management.

exams.name: Certified Information Systems Auditor
exams.blurb: Long-established ISACA credential for IT auditors covering audit process, governance, acquisition, operations and protection of information assets.

exams.name: ISACA Advanced in AI Audit
exams.blurb: ISACA credential for experienced auditors covering artificial intelligence governance, AI risk, model assurance and auditing AI-enabled systems.

exams.name: ISACA Advanced in AI Security Management
exams.blurb: ISACA certification for security managers covering AI governance, AI risk management, and securing and monitoring AI systems in the enterprise.

exams.name: ISACA Certified in Emerging Technology
exams.blurb: Stackable ISACA credential awarded for completing certificates in cloud fundamentals, blockchain, artificial intelligence and internet of things.

exams.name: ISACA Cybersecurity Practitioner Certification
exams.blurb: Performance-based ISACA exam conducted in a live virtual environment covering identification, protection, detection, response and recovery tasks.

exams.name: Artificial Intelligence Governance Professional
exams.blurb: IAPP certification covering AI governance, responsible AI development, the EU AI Act, risk management and AI system lifecycle accountability.

exams.name: Certified Information Privacy Manager
exams.blurb: IAPP certification on operationalising privacy, covering programme governance, privacy assessments, policy frameworks, metrics and breach response.

exams.name: Certified Information Privacy Professional/Europe
exams.blurb: IAPP certification on European data protection law, focused on the GDPR, lawful bases, data subject rights and international transfer mechanisms.

exams.name: Certified Information Privacy Professional/United States
exams.blurb: IAPP certification on US privacy law covering federal and state regimes, sectoral rules, private-sector obligations and government access to data.

exams.name: Certified Information Privacy Technologist
exams.blurb: IAPP technical privacy certification covering privacy by design, privacy engineering techniques, de-identification and privacy risk in IT systems.

exams.name: Blue Team Level 1
exams.blurb: Hands-on defensive security certification covering phishing analysis, digital forensics, SIEM, threat intelligence and incident response.

exams.name: Blue Team Level 2
exams.blurb: Advanced Security Blue Team certification covering malware analysis, threat hunting, advanced SIEM use and enterprise-scale incident response.

exams.name: Certificate of Cloud Auditing Knowledge
exams.blurb: Joint CSA and ISACA credential on auditing cloud environments, covering cloud compliance programmes, control frameworks and continuous assurance.

exams.name: Certificate of Cloud Security Knowledge
exams.blurb: Vendor-neutral cloud security certificate based on the CSA Security Guidance and Cloud Controls Matrix, covering governance and technical controls.

exams.name: TryHackMe Security Analyst Level 1
exams.blurb: Practical entry-level TryHackMe certification testing SOC analyst skills including triage, log review, network analysis and phishing investigation.
